chunks: So he who does the right and is a believer, will not have his labour denied, for We are cognisant of it.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the good deeds of a believer according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *la kufrana li sa'yih* (no ingratitude for his effort), affirming that righteous deeds of believers are preserved and rewarded without diminution, reflecting God's justice and mercy. It serves as a foundational assurance for the faithful that their spiritual labor is eternally recorded by Allah, reinforcing the concept of divine accountability in both this world and the Hereafter.
